name: MVGS_NS_COSMIC
description: COSMIC (Catalogue Of Somatic Mutations In Cancer) as a code system URI, used for mutational signature ids of the COSMIC SBS catalogue (e.g. SBS6; catalogue version such as 'COSMIC v3.3' in Coding.version) and other COSMIC identifiers (e.g. COSF fusion ids, as in the MII MTB example Observation-MII-EXA-MTB-RNA-Fusion-1). No FHIR CodeSystem is published (COSMIC licence); no other NamingSystem defines this URI (DISCUSS-TD #20, REVIEW-TD C). Interim until MII or HL7 THO registers one.
usage: Observation.valueCodeableConcept.coding.system of mii-pr-mtb-molekularer-biomarker instances with code mvgs-cs-molecular-feature#sbs-signature; codes are normalised without blanks (KDK 'SBS 6' -> 'SBS6').
